outcome: Cesarean delivery indicated by intermediate/abnormal fetal heart rate tracing
cohort: 37,856 singleton pregnancies at term (12,564 nulliparous and 25,292 multiparous women)
finding: Decreased fetal movement (DFM) was associated with different pregnancy outcomes based on parity.
mod_finding: DFM was associated with increased risk of cesarean delivery in both nulliparous and multiparous women.
